name: Stride Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your next {{term:agility|Agility}} Roll.

name: Bolster Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your next {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll.

name: Control Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your next {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll.

name: Attune Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your next {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll.

name: Charm Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your next {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll.

name: Enlighten Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your next {{term:knowledge|Knowledge}} Roll.

name: Minor Health Potion
text: Clear 1d4 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Minor Stamina Potion
text: Clear 1d4 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Grindletooth Venom
text: You can apply this venom to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d6 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

name: Varik Leaves
text: You can eat these paired leaves to immediately gain 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Vial of Moondrip
text: When you drink the contents of this vial, you can see in total darkness until your next rest.

name: Unstable Arcane Shard
text: You can make a {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within {{term:far|Far range}}. Targets you succeed against take 1d20 magic damage.

name: Potion of Stability
text: You can drink this potion to choose one additional {{term:downtime|downtime move}}.

name: Improved Grindletooth Venom
text: You can apply this venom to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d8 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

name: Morphing Clay
text: You can spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} to use this clay, altering your face enough to make you unrecognizable until your next rest.

name: Vial of Darksmoke
text: When an adversary attacks you, use this vial and roll a number of d6s equal to your {{term:agility|Agility}}. Add the highest result to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} against the attack.

name: Jumping Root
text: Eat this root to leap up to {{term:far|Far range}} once without needing to roll.

name: Snap Powder
text: Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and clear a {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Health Potion
text: Clear 1d4+1 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Stamina Potion
text: Clear 1d4+1 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Armor Stitcher
text: You can use this stitcher to spend any number of {{term:hope|Hope}} and clear that many {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}}.

name: Gill Salve
text: You can apply this salve to your neck to breathe underwater for a number of minutes equal to your level.

name: Replication Parchment
text: By touching this piece of parchment to another, you can perfectly copy the second parchment’s contents. Once used, this parchment becomes mundane paper.

name: Improved Arcane Shard
text: You can make a {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within {{term:far|Far range}}. Targets you succeed against take 2d20 magic damage.

name: Major Stride Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:agility|Agility}} until your next rest.

name: Major Bolster Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:strength|Strength}} until your next rest.

name: Major Control Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:finesse|Finesse}} until your next rest.

name: Major Attune Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:instinct|Instinct}} until your next rest.

name: Major Charm Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:presence|Presence}} until your next rest.

name: Major Enlighten Potion
text: You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:knowledge|Knowledge}} until your next rest.

name: Blood of the Yorgi
text: You can drink this blood to disappear from where you are and immediately reappear at a point you can see within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}.

name: Homet’s Secret Potion
text: After drinking this potion, the next successful attack you make {{term:critical-success|critically succeeds}}.

name: Redthorn Saliva
text: You can apply this saliva to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

name: Channelstone
text: You can use this stone to take a spell or grimoire from your {{term:vault|vault}}, use it once, and return it to your {{term:vault|vault}}.

name: Mythic Dust
text: You can apply this dust to a weapon that deals magic damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

name: Acidpaste
text: This paste eats away walls and other surfaces in bright flashes.

name: Hopehold Flare
text: When you use this flare, allies within {{term:close|Close range}} roll a d6 when they spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}. On a result of 6, they gain the effect of that {{term:hope|Hope}} without spending it. The flare lasts until the end of the scene.

name: Major Arcane Shard
text: You can make a {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within {{term:far|Far range}}. Targets you succeed against take 4d20 magic damage.

name: Featherbone
text: You can use this bone to control your falling speed for a number of minutes equal to your level.

name: Circle of the Void
text: Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} to create a void that extends up to {{term:far|Far range}}. No magic can be cast inside the void, and creatures within the void are {{term:immunity|immune}} to magic damage.

name: Sun Tree Sap
text: Consume this sap to roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, clear 2 {{term:hit-points|HP}}. On a result of 2–4, clear 3 {{term:stress|Stress}}. On a result of 1, see through the veil of death and return changed, gaining one {{term:scar|scar}}.

name: Dripfang Poison
text: A creature who consumes this poison takes 8d10 direct magic damage.

name: Major Health Potion
text: Clear 1d4+2 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Major Stamina Potion
text: Clear 1d4+2 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Ogre Musk
text: You can use this musk to prevent anyone from tracking you by mundane or magical means until your next rest.

name: Wingsprout
text: You gain magic wings that allow you to fly for a number of minutes equal to your level.

name: Jar of Lost Voices
text: You can open this jar to release a deafening echo of voices for a number of minutes equal to your {{term:instinct|Instinct}}. Creatures within {{term:far|Far range}} unprepared for the sound take 6d8 magic damage.

name: Dragonbloom Tea
text: You can drink this tea to unleash a fiery breath attack. Make an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll against all adversaries in front of you within {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets you succeed against take d20 physical damage using your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.

name: Bridge Seed
text: Thick vines grow from your location to a point of your choice within {{term:far|Far range}}, allowing you to climb up or across them. The vines dissipate on your next {{term:short-rest|short rest}}.

name: Sleeping Sap
text: You can drink this potion to fall asleep for a full night’s rest. You clear all {{term:stress|Stress}} upon waking.

name: Feast of Xuria
text: You can eat this meal to clear all {{term:hit-points|HP}} and {{term:stress|Stress}} and gain 1d4 {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Bonding Honey
text: This honey can be used to glue two objects together permanently.

name: Shrinking Potion
text: You can drink this potion to halve your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to {{term:agility|Agility}} and a −1 penalty to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.

name: Growing Potion
text: You can drink this potion to double your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to {{term:strength|Strength}} and a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.

name: Knowledge Stone
text: If you die while holding this stone, an ally can take a card from your {{term:loadout|loadout}} to place in their {{term:loadout|loadout}} or {{term:vault|vault}}. After they take this knowledge, the stone crumbles.

name: Sweet Moss
text: You can consume this moss during a rest to clear 1d10 {{term:hit-points|HP}} or 1d10 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Blinding Orb
text: You can activate this orb to create a flash of bright light. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} become _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they mark {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Death Tea
text: After you drink this tea, you instantly kill your target when you critically succeed on an attack. If you don’t critically succeed on an attack before your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, you die.

name: Mirror of Marigold
text: When you take damage, you can spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} to negate that damage, after which the mirror shatters.

name: Stardrop
text: You can use this stardrop to summon a hailstorm of comets that deals 8d20 physical damage to all targets within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}.

name: Warding Candle
text: You can light this candle to fill an area within {{term:close|Close range}} with a halo of light. A creature outside the halo can’t enter it if they have ill intent toward a creature within it. The candle burns for an hour.

name: Iridian Dust
text: This multicolored powder sticks to everything and prevents creatures covered in it from becoming _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_.

name: Verglasian Seed
text: You can use this ice shard to instantly freeze an area of water up to {{term:close|Close range}}.

name: Cupbearer’s Bezoar
text: You can swallow this bezoar to become {{term:immunity|immune}} to poisons until your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Mossmantle Potion
text: You can drink this tea to perfectly blend into natural environments until your next rest.

name: Lyrebird Lozenge
text: You can dissolve this lozenge in your mouth to perfectly mimic any voice you’ve heard until the end of the scene.

name: Vial of Featherfall
text: You can drink this potion to ignore damage from falling for the next 10 minutes.

name: Chimeric Saliva
text: You can apply this saliva to a weapon that deals physical damage to change its damage type to magic until your next rest.

name: Packet of Space Dust
text: This dust causes anything it covers to become lighter than air. One packet contains enough dust to cover the contents of a picnic basket, and the effects last for an hour.

name: Pipeweed
text: When you choose the Clear {{term:stress|Stress}} {{term:downtime|downtime move}} during a {{term:short-rest|short rest}}, you can smoke this non-intoxicating leaf to clear an additional {{term:stress|Stress}}. Any other PCs who chose the Clear {{term:stress|Stress}} {{term:downtime|downtime move}} also gain this benefit.

name: Deathseer’s Powder
text: You can sprinkle this powder over a recently deceased corpse to conjure a spectral reprise of their final minute of life.

name: Slayer’s Salt
text: You can spread this salt in a line along windowsills or thresholds to create a magical barrier that undead creatures can’t cross until the line is broken.

name: Yakamel Milk
text: After consuming this milk, the next time you clear 1 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}, you clear an additional {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

name: Glowmoss Mushroom
text: You can break this mushroom into pieces, causing it to glow bright blue until your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Red Ooze Oil
text: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Ignites_ the target. While _Ignited_, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they take the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}}.

name: Instant Camp
text: You can unfold this small mechanical box into a camping tent large enough to safely house six people. The tent collapses at the end of your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Bundle of Spiderlegs
text: You can eat these spiderlegs to walk on walls until your next rest.

name: Ciscan Fog Bottle
text: You can break this jar to fill the area within {{term:close|Close range}} with magical mist. A creature who enters the mist clears a {{term:stress|Stress}} and becomes _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_.

name: Snapthorn Seed
text: You can throw this seed at a point you can see. It explodes into a tangle of binding vines that {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Restrains_ all creatures within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point.

name: Sprite Bottle
text: When you mark your last {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}, this bottle shatters to release the Sprite inside. The Sprite clears all your {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} before fading from the Mortal Realm.

name: Gravity Bomb
text: You can throw this peach-sized mechanical orb at a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. It implodes and pulls all creatures and objects within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point into {{term:melee|Melee range}} with it.

name: Gossip Flower
text: You can plant this seed in soil. It instantly grows into a small flower that records everything it hears for up to one week. When plucked, the flower recites what it recorded in real time, then withers.

name: Displacement Token
text: You can swallow this token to conjure two illusions of yourself that you can control. Each illusion lasts until it takes damage or until your next rest.

name: Night Hag’s Dust
text: You can blow this dust in an adversary’s face to prevent them from clearing {{term:stress|Stress}} until your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Self-Sewing Thread
text: You can use this thread to clear either a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} or 2 {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}}.

name: Stonemason’s Fortune
text: When you throw this gray brick on the ground, it immediately grows into a 6-foot-tall, 10-foot-wide, and 2-foot-deep wall of solid stone.

name: Mnemonic Potion
text: You can drink this potion to Utilize an {{term:experience|Experience}} without spending a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Salamander Salve
text: You can apply this salve to your skin to make yourself {{term:immunity|immune}} to heat until your next rest.

name: Green Ooze Oil
text: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Corrodes_ the target. While _Corroded,_ the target gains a −2 penalty to their {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}.

name: Sunlight Orb
text: You can shatter this orb to make the area within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}} appear as though it’s sunlit daytime for the next 24 hours.

name: Moonlight Orb
text: You can shatter this orb to make the area within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}} appear as though it’s moonlit nighttime for the next 24 hours.

name: Midas Flask
text: You can pour this small flask of alchemical liquid over a mundane item to instantly transmute it into a handful of gold.

name: Staff of Reversal
text: You can break this staff against the ground to reverse one magical transformation or effect within {{term:far|Far range}}.

name: Berserker’s Brew
text: When you drink this dram of liquid, you gain a bonus to your {{term:strength|Strength}} and a penalty to your {{term:finesse|Finesse}} and {{term:knowledge|Knowledge}} equal to your {{term:instinct|Instinct}} (minimum 1). This effect lasts until you make a {{term:death-move|death move}} or until your next rest.

name: Emberite Shard
text: Choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point must succeed on a {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Ablaze_. While _Ablaze_, a creature must roll a d4 whenever they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}. On a result of 1, they mark a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}. On a result of 4, they clear the _Ablaze_ condition.

name: Arcticite Shard
text: Choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point must succeed on a {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ by ice.

name: Fulgurite Shard
text: Choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point must succeed on a {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and mark 1d4 {{term:stress|Stress}} as lightning crackles through the area.

name: Demiurge’s Draught
text: You can drink this draught to gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} for your next successful attack roll.

name: Cockerel Claw Tea
text: You can drink this tea to refresh your features as if you had taken a {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Potion of Vigilance
text: You can drink this potion to gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} until you mark a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

name: Cacophonous Concoction
text: When you drink this potion, anything you say or do in the next hour becomes impossible for a witness to recount. Any attempts they make to communicate what they saw, heard, or otherwise sensed comes out garbled or nonsensical.

name: Nightmare Mead
text: You can drink this potion to discover the deepest fear of the next person you make eye contact with. When you do, the GM gains a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Stake of Abjuration
text: You can hammer this stake into the ground and make a proclamation. Until your next rest, a creature within {{term:far|Far range}} of the stake who transgresses that proclamation must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}. The stake lasts until your next rest, then it shatters.

name: Psychopomp’s Shroud
text: You can place this shroud over the corpse of a recently deceased creature. The creature’s spirit enters the shroud and becomes your spectral assistant until the next sunrise, when they pass through the veil of death and take the shroud with them.

name: Phial of Deep Ink
text: You can drink this bottle of ink to transform into a cephalopod of roughly your size for the next hour. You gain rubbery skin, soft bones, the ability to breathe underwater, and new limbs until you have eight total.

name: Mesmer’s Tonic
text: When you drink this tonic, the only thing you can hear until your next rest are the surface thoughts of creatures within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}.

name: Invisibility Potion
text: You are _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ until you deal damage to another creature or until your next rest.

name: Formoid Serum
text: You can drink this potion to become a swarm of 16 million ants until the end of the scene. You keep and have access to all equipment, loot, and features.

name: Steelskin Salve
text: You can apply this salve to your skin to gain a bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}} equal to your {{term:tier|tier}} until the end of the scene.

name: Godling’s Pomelo
text: You can eat this citrus fruit to clear all {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} and {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Snakeskin Spirit
text: You can drink this potion to slough off your outer layer of skin and heal a {{term:scar|scar}}.

name: Magic-User’s Malison
text: When you release this spellcaster’s trapped soul, you can cast one spell from a card in your {{term:vault|vault}} as if it were in your {{term:loadout|loadout}}. This doesn’t work for permanently vaulted cards.

name: Quintessential Severant
text: You can use this magic blade to cut one magical or metaphysical bond, such as an enchantment, contract, magical tether, or divine oath. When you do, the blade shatters.

name: Mask of the Echoed Self
text: You can wear this mask during your next level up to swap the values of any of your traits. When you do, the mask becomes your permanent face.

name: Necroprancer’s Bell
text: You can break this rusted, clapperless bell against the ground to summon a skeletal steed that climbs out of the earth and serves you until the next sunrise.

name: Drakemantle
text: You can use this enchanted ancient dragon hide to gain draconic characteristics until the end of the scene, when the hide falls aways in tatters. Until then, you can fly and gain a +5 bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}} and a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.

name: Gambler’s Fallacy
text: You can spend any number of handfuls of gold by placing them into this slotted ceramic jar shaped like a pig. When you throw the jar at a point within {{term:far|Far range}}, it explodes and deals 1d20 magic damage for each handful of gold spent to all creatures within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point. All gold within the jar is destroyed.

name: Lionheart Tonic
text: You can drink this tonic to gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} until you roll with {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Tears of the Undying Hero
text: When you drink this potion, death can’t touch you until your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}. When you would mark your last {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}, instead of making a {{term:death-move|death move}}, you make one final {{term:action-roll|action roll}} before falling into a dreamless slumber until an ally chooses the Tend to Wounds {{term:downtime|downtime move}} to clear your {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}.

name: Featherstep Potion
text: You can drink this potion to sprout small wings from your ankles that give you a bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} equal to your {{term:tier|tier}} until your next rest.
